policy: Farmer-facing lessons are original teaching text written for MenyaMuhinzi. They are informed by the references below and by standard smallholder tomato practice. Full guides are not copied into the course. A qualified agronomist must confirm varieties, spacing, and any input before real farmer training. Personalized spray or fertilizer rates are outside this phase.
